note: MISSION STUDIO (https://sanghyunpark.pages.dev/apps/mission-studio/) is capture-class: a static Cloudflare Pages deploy served under the /apps/mission-studio/ sub-path and captured with that exact directory tree at the repo root (dead-world precedent). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — no public upstream repo exists (the deploy carries no repo link and the captured bundle contains no GitHub/GitLab reference; GitHub search finds only unrelated projects), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/index-inline-N.pretty.{js,css} for the entry document's three inline blocks (style #1; script #1 the classic engine; script #2 the ES module) and readable/assets__<name>.pretty.js for the four captured vendor modules — every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source. src/: statement-aligned slices of the two inline scripts at top-level declaration boundaries (~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with the exact 2-line provenance header; every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Vendor rule — wholeFile sections, never sliced: the four captured three.js modules (three.module.min r160, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, meshopt_decoder) and the inline stylesheet; the two scripts' opener banners are wholeFile heads, indexed and never sliced. Binary payloads (GLB models, JPG/WebP textures, stars.json) are hashed notRendered records — carried byte-exact in the capture, no pretty pass. External (CDN rule, recorded in notRendered, never captured): the Google Fonts stylesheet + preconnects; the favicon is an inline data: SVG. Identifiers in src/ are the author's own names (the captured code is commented, human-written source — the banner comments are its real module names) — no rename campaign needed. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
